name: ryan-minato-skills
description: Curated Agent Skills library, distributed as per-catalog Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Skills recommended for global (user-level) installation: commits, sensitivity, skill authoring, methodology.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: General programming methodology skills and narrow artifact-authoring workflows (e.g. Dev Container artifacts).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Disposable, project-scoped builders for generic harness machinery: complete agent harness architecture, GitHub and GitLab lifecycle workflows, and Python convention defaults.

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: Disposable, project-scoped builders for a project of a specific topic (machine learning, data science), plus the disposal skill that removes them. Use whichever topic builder matches the project; remove them once the harness is verified.

plugins.name: util
plugins.description: Process skills that act on the collaboration itself — clarifying, questioning, deciding, and organizing ideas together. Independent of domain and tech stack, they produce a shared understanding rather than files and keep their working material out of the workspace.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Human-audience writing: genre skills (academic, blog/opinion, promotional copy) and medium skills (LaTeX, Typst, Markdown source).
